Verdict: needs_changes. Implementer target context correctly declares `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)`. I did not see a listed forbidden command shape in `target_context.commands_run`.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Missing fleet-summary UI omits the Add Project command-emission affordance. Evidence: `renderHeaderStripHTML()` returns only `renderMissingSummaryHTML()` when `envelope == null`, so `dontpanic projects add <name> <path>` is not shown in the missing/no-registry path. Recommendation: include the Add Project command row in the missing-summary state too.

FINDING (medium, correctness): `refreshState()` cannot show the missing-summary command if `fleet-summary.json` disappears after a previous successful load. Evidence: `loadState()` only assigns `this.state.fleetSummary` on `resp.ok`; 404/fetch failure leaves the old summary intact, so the fingerprint stays stale and the missing banner never renders. Recommendation: reset nullable aliased files like `fleetSummary` to `null` on non-OK/fetch failure and add a present-to-missing refresh test.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Scope labels are incomplete for V0 dashboard sections. Evidence: What Now only badges the header/empty state, while band panels render without scope labels; Capability Center badges the summary panel but not the capabilities cards panel. Plan text says every visible surface must declare Global, Project, or Fleet scope. Recommendation: rend

findings.issue: Missing fleet-summary UI omits the Add Project command-emission affordance. Evidence: `renderHeaderStripHTML()` returns only `renderMissingSummaryHTML()` when `envelope == null`, so `dontpanic projects add <name> <path>` is not shown in the missing/no-registry path. Recommendation: include the Add Project command row in the missing-summary state too.

`refreshState()` cannot show the missing-summary command if `fleet-summary.json` disappears after a previous successful load. Evidence: `loadState()` only assigns `this.state.fleetSummary` on `resp.ok`; 404/fetch failure leaves the old summary intact, so the fingerprint stays stale and the missing banner never renders. Recommendation: reset nullable aliased files like `fleetSummary` to `null` on non-OK/fetch failure and add a present-to-missing refresh test.

Scope labels are incomplete for V0 dashboard sections. Evidence: What Now only badges the header/empty state, while band panels render without scope labels; Capability Center badges the summary panel but not the capabilities cards panel. Plan text says every visible surface must declare Global, Project, or Fleet scope. Recommendation: render scope badges consistently on each V0 section/panel or explicitly narrow the section boundary in tests/docs.

The selector integration tests duplicate core shell logic instead of exercising `dashboard/core.js`, so core loader/refresh defects can pass. Evidence: `tests/integration/project-selector.test.js` defines its own `createShell()` and `loadFleetSummary()`; `core-router.test.js` still omits `fleetSummary`, `whatNow`, and `selectedProject`. Recommendation: update the core-router fixture or add an actual core integration path covering initial load, refresh, present-to-missing, and scope-label placeme
